plain: A named group within a religion, such as a church body

more.text: A class, society or collection of individuals, called by the same name; as a denomination of christians.

example.quote: We think too favorably of the justice and good sense of these denominations to believe that they either covet preeminences over their fellow citizens or that they will be seduced by them from the common opposition to the measure.
example.cite: James Madison, Memorial and Remonstrance Against Religious Assessments, c. June 20, 1785
